p.i: Quemadmodum Medicus, nisi praecognoscat corporea accidentia, quæ iuxta illius professionem notiones vocantur, nequit omnino curare aut mederi: ita & Sacerdos Medicus animarum nisi praecognoscat passiones animarum, nequit sanare.

main_text.p: Infirmi vero, qui celant suos morbos, & procu-rant, seipsos sanare, aberrant a suo scopo, quoniam infirma est eorum virtus, & pertur-batus humor, adeoque dulce videtur illis ama-rum. CONFIRMATIO. Iob: Si peccavi inuoluntarie, erubui a multitudine lasionis po-

page.notes: The Syriac block (about 11 lines) is not legible enough to transcribe letter by letter; the letter counts per line are estimates. "CONFIRMATIO" is a run-in heading inside the paragraph, so it is kept in the text. The catchword "puli." is the start of the word "populi" continued from the line end "po-". Printed spellings "lasionis" and the italic/roman mix are kept as printed.
